Welcome to Daily Physio Fix 🩺✨

I’m Dr. Maryam Riaz, a Physiotherapist graduated from Baqai Medical University.
On this channel, I share simple and effective physiotherapy exercises to help you relieve pain, improve posture, increase mobility, and live a healthier life.

Here you’ll find:
✅ Knee pain relief exercises
✅ Back & neck pain solutions
✅ Posture correction tips
✅ Daily stretching routines
✅ Home rehab exercises
✅ Easy fitness & mobility tips

My goal is to make physiotherapy simple, practical, and helpful for everyone. Whether you’re dealing with pain, stiffness, or poor posture — Daily Physio Fix is here to help you move better and feel better every day. 💪

📌 Subscribe now and start your journey toward a pain-free healthy lifestyle!
